At Viyaverse Pvt. Ltd. in the Maldives, I contributed to a GST calculator and management application for small businesses. 03 / Undergraduate researchAug 2026 – Present

AI critique with
designer intent.

Can an AI design assistant understand what a designer is trying to achieve?

My graduation research examines whether explicitly stated design intent improves multimodal AI feedback on visual work. The planned within-subject study compares critique produced from a design image and creative brief with critique that also receives designer-authored intent.

Human-centered AIHCIMultimodal AIResearch prototype

Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI. The frontend–backend data submission flow works; multimodal model integration remains in progress and a participant study has not yet been conducted.

SupervisorPeng Hong · Yunnan University
Study measuresRelevance, actionability, intent alignment, usefulness
Internship research and interface designFIGMA SOURCE
Research interface and study prototype

Interface reference for the undergraduate design-critique research.

View Figma design ↗
Condition A · Baseline

Design image + creative brief → AI-generated critique. This represents a conventional prompt without additional structured intent.

Condition B · Intent-aware

The same image and brief + designer intent fields: Goal, Preserve, Explore, Avoid and Constraints → critique evaluated on the same criteria.

05 / 3D language learning

Digital Companion Tuantuan

A 3D panda-led Chinese-language learning demonstration featuring scripted everyday scenarios, character animation and speech synthesis. I designed the website interface and supporting visual assets and implemented the frontend directly in code. Other teammates produced videos and researched and prepared the learning content. The experience is a scripted demonstration, not an autonomous AI chatbot.

A little about me

From code to
human experience.

I'm completing a bachelor's degree in Software Engineering at Yunnan University. I designed the ViyaGST mobile and web interfaces during my remote work with Viyaverse, and I developed the interfaces for several university team projects directly through code.

My practice connects visual decisions with implementation. I work across layout, information structure and interaction, using prototypes to examine how those decisions hold together.
